summary: Vox Royalty Corp. announced via Form 6-K that its subsidiary, Vox Royalty Australia Pty Ltd., entered a binding agreement to acquire a 2.0% net smelter return royalty over the White Dam gold mine in South Australia from an unnamed Australian mining company. Total upfront cash consideration is A$5,000,000 (approximately US$3.4 million). The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent. White Dam, operated by Broken Hill Gold Limited, restarted production in April 2026 and targets 15,000–20,000 ounces annually. The royalty covers ~400 km² with exploration upside. Watch for closing conditions and production ramp-up milestones.
